scope_note: Everything under lucis.life. Vendor infra in scope when it runs Lucis code or stores Lucis data: Clerk FAPI (clerk/accounts.lucis.life), Strapi CMS on Koyeb (cms.lucis.life), PostHog proxy (pthg/ph), Vercel-hosted Next.js (www/app/apex). Out of scope: customer.io (cio/sms) marketing, Notion (career), Intercom (assets-inter), getprobo (compliance) are separate vendor products Lucis merely links/embeds.

Cross-tenant IDOR: G1->G2 and G2->G1 object access tested on /v1/orders, /v1/addresses (GET,PATCH,DELETE), /v1/users/{uuid}, /v1/users/me, /v1/dashboard/auth/current-user, /v1/users/update-basic-account-info (UUID injection). All properly scoped: 404 for cross-account, UUID in body silently ignored. No BOLA found.
Mass assignment: /v1/join rejects unexpected fields (uuid, role, status, isAdmin, isVip). /v1/users/update-basic-account-info silently ignores uuid. Strict allowlist validation on both endpoints.
Vertical privesc: /v1/admin/*, /v1/dev/seed-members, /v1/dev/seed-members/sign-in-token all 404 in prod. X-User-Role/X-User-Status header injection ignored.
/v1/public/* object-by-id routes: 404 on known UUIDs (payments, carts from Account1/Account2). No unauth data leak.
Basket/checkout 500 on empty items: unhandled exception ('Cannot read properties of undefined reading currency'), bug but not security-exploitable.
Subscription gate bypass: X-Subscription-Status, X-Forwarded-For:127.0.0.1, query params all ignored. 403 is server-side from member status.
Price manipulation in checkout: /v1/basket/checkout ignores client-side price/unitAmount fields. Total always calculated server-side from serviceId. Negative quantity properly rejected.
Coupon injection: couponCode field accepted but unknown codes cause 500 PROMO_CONVERSION_FAILED (not exploitable). Self-referral (referralCode=own code) accepted but discount NOT applied.
Webhook endpoints: /v1/webhooks/stripe validates Stripe signatures (401). /v1/webhooks/clerk validates Clerk signatures (401). Both properly secured.
No GraphQL endpoint, no Swagger/OpenAPI docs exposed, no actuator/debug/metrics/env endpoints, no .env file accessible.

Injection testing: SQL injection on /v1/public/services?country= -> 400. Path traversal normalized by Cloudflare (307 redirect, then 404). SSTI on gift card code -> normal 404. CRLF injection -> normal response. NoSQL injection on referral-links -> returns default empty data (not injection).
Open redirect: not found on www.lucis.life or app.lucis.life. No redirect/login endpoints with url parameters.
Source maps: not exposed on app.lucis.life or www.lucis.life (_next/static/*.js.map -> 404 on all tested chunks).
HTTP method override: X-HTTP-Method-Override header ignored by NestJS.
API versioning: no /v2/ or /api/ prefix exists.
Member enumeration: /v1/users and /v1/members both 404 (no list endpoint).
Account deletion: DELETE /v1/users/me returns 404 (no delete endpoint).
Rate limiting present: x-ratelimit-limit:60, x-ratelimit-remaining:59, x-ratelimit-reset:60 on public endpoints.

OIDC SSRF via metadata URIs: registration accepts internal URIs (169.254.169.254, localhost) but strips them from response. No out-of-band callback to confirm server-side fetch. Unconfirmed - flagged as manual Burp Collaborator step.

OIDC redirect_uri validation: authorization endpoint redirects to sign-in before validating redirect_uri. Redirect URIs restricted to loopback only for registered clients. Client_credentials grant downgraded. Scope downgraded to openid only.

Public checkout session status: /v1/public/checkout-sessions/{id} returns limited data (isValid, isPaid, status, paymentStatus). No PII. IDs are long random Stripe strings, not enumerable. By design for checkout completion flow.

Security headers (CORRECTED by infra recon): api.lucis.life and mcp.lucis.life have full CSP+HSTS+X-Frame+X-CTO+Referrer. www.lucis.life missing CSP and Permissions-Policy, leaks X-Powered-By: Next.js. app.lucis.life has minimal CSP (frame-ancestors only, no script-src/default-src); /signin page has NO CSP. cms.lucis.life leaks X-Powered-By: Strapi <strapi.io>. assets.lucis.life missing ALL security headers. admin.lucis.life missing all headers (just a redirect). Defense-in-depth only, no exploitable vulnerability without an XSS vector.

Clerk environment config: test_mode=false, captcha disabled, social OAuth empty, SAML disabled, organizations disabled. No misconfigurations found.

mcp.lucis.life: Live NestJS service. /health returns database:up. /v1/mcp returns 401 requiring Clerk OAuth Bearer with scopes health:read,care:read,orders:read. Properly authenticated. CORS is wildcard but requires Bearer tokens so no credential-based CORS abuse.
www.lucis.life developer endpoints (/llms.txt, /index.md, /auth.md, /webhooks.md, /docs/mcp.md, /openapi.json): intentional public documentation. No sensitive data. No member API exposed.

Cookies: www.lucis.life sets NEXT_LOCALE (no sensitive flags needed). clerk.lucis.life sets __cf_bm and _cfuvid (HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=None, Domain=clerk-specific). api.lucis.life sets no cookies. No cross-subdomain session cookies found.

PostHog SERVER_* feature flags exposed via /decide: names like SERVER_JOBS_IMPORT_BIOMARKER_RESULT_MODE:dry_run, SERVER_REPORT_DISPATCHER:live, KIT_FULFILLMENT_PROVIDER:bigblue. These are backend config names with values exposed to client-side. PostHog /decide is designed for this use case; recommend marking SERVER_* flags as server-only in PostHog to avoid exposing operational details.

Newly discovered public endpoints from bundle analysis: /v1/public/default-country (200, returns US), /v1/public/addons (400 needs params), /v1/public/service-subscriptions (400 needs params), /v1/public/labs/nearest (400 needs params). All properly validate input. /v1/users/by-email and /v1/users/by-referral-code both return 403 (auth required). /v1/logs returns 404. /v1/protected/campaigns returns 401.
DNS zone transfer: blocked by Cloudflare. No wildcard DNS (random subdomains return NXDOMAIN).
Cloudflare direct IP access: 104.20.17.16 and 172.66.153.103 reject connections with mismatched SNI/Host (connection reset). Origin IPs not discoverable.
Host header injection: blocked by Cloudflare on all proxied hosts (403 on mismatched Host header). X-Forwarded-Host ignored by CMS.

Cloud storage buckets: assets.lucis.life (AWS S3 eu-west-3 behind CloudFront+Cloudflare), miraculous-fireworks-748b2a2a2a.media.strapiapp.com (DO Spaces ams3c), probo-eu-west-1-files-897729133226.s3.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com (AWS S3 eu-west-1) - all properly deny listing/public access. Strapi media files accessible by hash URL (by design).

Email infrastructure: SPF (v=spf1 include:_spf.google.com ~all) + DMARC (v=DMARC1; p=reject; adkim=r; aspf=r) + DKIM (google selector RSA 2048-bit) + MX (Google Workspace). DMARC p=reject compensates for SPF softfail. No spoofing possible.
Subdomain enumeration: 100+ common names tested via DNS-over-HTTPS + crt.sh CT logs. 16 unique subdomains found (all already known). No hidden/staging/dev subdomains discovered.

Wearable integration subdomains (strava-connect, garmin, whoop) bypass Cloudflare: DNS A records point directly to Google Cloud IPs (8.232.30.149, 8.232.136.164). Response: via: 1.1 google. Services return 502/503 on all paths. Non-functional, no exploitable attack surface currently.

CORS on non-CMS hosts: api.lucis.life and mcp.lucis.life use wildcard origin (*) without credentials (safe pattern). app.lucis.life fixed to https://www.lucis.life only. Wearable endpoints, assets, admin, faq, compliance return no CORS headers.
Tailscale admin endpoint: admin.lucis.life is a wildcard 302 redirect to admin-prd.lucis.ts.net/[path]. Domain is hardcoded (not an open redirect). Tailscale endpoint not publicly accessible.
HTTP->HTTPS redirects: all Cloudflare-proxied hosts properly redirect HTTP to HTTPS (301/302). Wearable hosts return 503 on HTTP (services down).
Port scanning on wearable IPs: only ports 80 and 443 respond (503 from Google Cloud proxy). All other tested ports (8080, 8443, 3000, 4000, 5000, 9090) timeout.
No CAA records set on lucis.life. No SRV records. No autoconfig/autodiscover records.
open_threads: OIDC SSRF via metadata URIs: needs out-of-band callback (Burp Collaborator or similar) to confirm whether server fetches logo_uri/client_uri/sector_identifier_uri. Manual step.
Auth token lifecycle: Clerk JWTs have 60s TTL (auto-expire). Revoking a session to test token invalidation would lock out the test account. Low priority given the short TTL.
